explicit.text_template: Per CRE {cre}, verify that user-set passwords are at least 12 characters in length after removing leading and trailing whitespace.
Refer to CRE {cre}. Verify that cookie-based session tokens have the Secure attribute set.
This control corresponds to CRE {cre}: passwords shall be stored using an approved key derivation function.
See CRE {cre} for the canonical guidance on enforcing access control rules at a trusted service layer.

ambiguous.text: Verify the use of a secure software development lifecycle that addresses security in all stages of development.
Security is everyone's responsibility and should be considered throughout the organization.
